consent_prompt:
Welcome to Sọ̀rọ̀ 👋 Talk am, I go write am.
Tell me what you spend, earn, sell or lend, by voice note or text, and I'll keep the record. Ask "Where my money dey go?" anytime.

We save what you tell us so we can answer you. We do not store your phone number. Type DELETE anytime to remove everything.
Privacy: {privacy_url}

Do you agree?
consent_declined: No wahala. If you change your mind, just send any message.
welcome:
You're set! ✅ Send me a voice note or text like:
• "I buy data 1,500"
• "My salary don enter, 150k"
• "My food budget this month na 40k"
• "Mama Chidi owe me 5k"
• "I sell 3 bags of rice, 75k"
• "Where my money dey go this week?"

Type HELP anytime, UNDO to remove the last record.
help:
Here is what I can do:
🛒 Sales or work done: "I sell 2 crates of egg 9k", "I collect 8k for sewing"
💸 Spending: "I pay shop rent 30k", "I buy data 1,500", "I chop 2k"
💰 Money in: "My salary don enter 150k", "My papa send me 20k"
📒 Debts: "Emeka owe me 4k", "Emeka don pay me 4k", "I owe supplier 20k"
🎯 Budget: "My food budget this month na 40k"
📦 Stock: "I get 10 cartons of Indomie left"
📊 Summary: "Where my money dey go this week?"
🏦 Loan: "I need 100k loan to buy goods"
💡 Money tips: ask any question

✏️ Mistake? Say "no be 5k, na 50k", or type UNDO to remove the last record.
Type SHARE to invite friends, LANGUAGE to change language, DELETE to remove your data.

Sọ̀rọ̀ uses N-ATLaS, an initiative of the Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy, powered by Awarri Technologies.

expense_logged:
✅ Expense recorded: {what}{amount}.
Today's expenses so far: {today_total}.
need_amount: I hear you, but how much? Send it again with the amount, like "I sell 2 crates of egg, 9k".
need_item: Which goods? Send it again with the item and quantity, like "I get 10 cartons of Indomie left".
summary_empty: 📊 Nothing recorded {period} yet. Start with a voice note like "I sell 2 crates of egg, 9k" or "I buy data 1,500".
income_logged:
💰 Money in: {what}{amount}.
Money in this month: {month_total}.
budget_status: 🎯 {category} this month: {spent} of your {budget} budget ({left} left).
budget_over: ⚠️ {category} this month: {spent}. That is {over} over your {budget} budget.
budget_set:
🎯 Budget set: {category}, {amount} a month.
Spent on it so far this month: {spent}.
need_category: Budget for what? Say it like "My food budget this month na 40k".
undone:
↩️ Removed: {what}.
If it was wrong, send it again the right way.
nothing_to_undo: There is nothing to remove yet.
cannot_correct: I can only fix an amount. Type UNDO to remove that record, then send it again.
summary_share: Know someone who should track their money? Type SHARE.
share_intro:
Forward the next message to your friends, family and WhatsApp groups 👇
People who joined with your link so far: {count}
share_message: I dey use Sọ̀rọ̀ to track my money with voice notes on WhatsApp. I just talk, e write am down, and e fit tell me where my money dey go. E understand English, Pidgin, Yoruba, Hausa and Igbo, and e free. Try am: {link}
loan_logged:
🏦 Noted: you need {amount}{purpose}.
Sọ̀rọ̀ does not give loans itself. We are keeping your request so we can connect you when partner lenders join. Keep recording your sales: good records help you get a loan.
greeting: Hello! 👋 Send me a voice note about money you made, spent or are owed, or ask me any money question. Type HELP to see examples.
unknown: Sorry, I no understand well. Try again in short words, or type HELP to see examples.
unsupported_type: Please send a voice note or text. I can't read pictures or videos yet.
transcribe_empty: I no hear anything for that voice note. Please try again and speak close to the phone.
delete_confirm: This will delete ALL your records with Sọ̀rọ̀. Are you sure?
deleted: Done. Everything is deleted. Send any message if you want to start again.
error: Sorry, something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a minute.
